goal: Replace the one-round pass-through at an exhausted Review rework budget with one literal-user decision offering three exits: grant N more rounds, accept remaining Review findings as residual risk, or replan.

acceptance.assertion: Meet S2 in docs/specs/review-convergence.spec.md: from a record parked by budget exhaustion, authorize_rework with rounds N (1-5) parks again only after N further blocking rounds; accept_residual_risk with literal-user authority and a non-empty reason resolves the boundary, moves open blocking Review findings to accepted_risk, and permits completion only when QA and acceptance obligations are met; the same action from review, qa, or parent authority, without a reason, or on a repeated-security-boundary dispute is rejected with zero writes; Claude and Pi present the same three exits; an unattended batch parks instead of choosing an exit; records without the new fields parse and behave unchanged.
